selection: minimum uncalibrated development soft cross entropy
calibration: single scalar temperature, 81-point grid 1.0..2.0, fitted only on separate calibration cases
official_test: 1000 cases read only after selection and temperature fitting
limitations: Targets are multiple-choice gold, not teacher distributions and not measured action success.
Qwen3.5 uses a Gated DeltaNet plus gated attention hybrid, so activation accounting differs from a plain transformer; the memory guard is required, not optional.
Dedup key is image sha256; ScienceQA reuses the same image across its own splits.
